title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer Terms: Share of the Correction Quote Collected at Authorization
content:
The share of the correction quote collected at authorization of an alignment correction on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is the **whole quote (1)** where the customer's most recent estimate booking that ended as a no-show closed no more than 183 days before the authorization, **three quarters (0.75)** where it closed more than 183 but no more than 730 days before, and **half (0.5)** otherwise.

## Records the share is read from

The share is read from the customer's Repair Estimates & Appointments bookings: the most recent booking that ended with the status no-show, and the date it closed. Days are calendar days counted from that closed date to the day of the authorization, the closed date not counted. Where the customer has no estimate booking that ended as a no-show, the days are taken as 99999 and the share is half.

## Share by no-show history

| Most recent no-show booking closed, days before the authorization | Share of the correction quote collected |
|---|---|
| no more than 183 | the whole quote (1) |
| more than 183, no more than 730 | three quarters (0.75) |
| more than 730, or no no-show booking | half (0.5) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Closed 183 days before the authorization: the whole quote.
- Closed 184 days before: three quarters.
- Closed 730 days before: three quarters.
- Closed 731 days before: half.

## Illustration (hypothetical correction quote of 100.00 USD)

The share collected is 100.00 USD at the whole quote, 75.00 USD at three quarters and 50.00 USD at half.
